pages.title: Rules — the checklist
items: Cards (status and Update) are OFF through about 09-12 — her word lifts it; the wrap-up still goes at the end.
What we are on: a 480p Mini draft of the ward film, re-shot landscape, main shots only, every clip through APIFRAME; then 720p on 2.5 (~09-16); then off Mini (~09-19).
Wan 3.0 rides the Atlas door. A "does NOT appear" line keeps nobody out — leave the reference out instead.
Sophie's pajama reference is one full-body still, nothing else.
Money spent this turn is said only if any — in dollars, never credits.
File yourself in her own words; re-file when the subject changes.
A measurement she did not ask for stays out of the reply.
Pin a link only for a page you are working on or a deliverable you keep re-handing her; most chats have no pin.
A film, audio cut or finished page goes on the deliverables list — and the reply carries the link; a /api/drop/file link is the save link, never the way to watch.
A final export gets a clean copy (metadata stripped, pixels hash-verified) filed into the Dump.
Cutting a film is a Film Editor cut doc: build the two lanes, render through it, pin with cut:<id>, diff first when she writes back.
A film made of pictures gets its shot map filed (that is the Prompt button on the paused player).
A bug fix reply opens with the surface it shows on, says whether it is live; the PR rides last.
Merge your own PR before wrapping up; a draft is not a parking space; ask her only about deploying.
Leave a wrap-up: her three questions, one sentence each.
A chat tagged bug fix archives itself when the fix landed clean.
Nothing is drawn or animated unless she says make it; a subject and a budget is asking for the list.
No video clip is sent without her "go" for that exact job: show model, seconds, resolution, the exact prompt, every reference; read back what the API received.
Which door: APIFRAME during the draft; a person reference goes to Atlas or APIFRAME; person-free goes cheapest; a refused job is never re-sent through another door or without its references.
A reference is never described in the prompt — name its slot; camera at eye level.
Every clip's exact prompt and references are logged by the server — send chat, scene and title.
Minimum seconds unless she specifies.
An image prompt is short and action-only, and names the thing, not its parts; hers goes verbatim.
Every image: label it, file MODEL · QUALITY · SIZE (the tier), post the exact prompt split style/content, stamp the prompt into the file, say word for word anything you added, run the caption sweep.
When she messages: sweep notes, votes and to-dos — and sweep again before saying done; her notes land after the message that announces them.
The bell is on by default; never turn one off.
Building a page: the new-page skill first, start from the shell, fix any warnings before the turn ends.
Never block the turn on a wait; Mac-only tasks go in docs/desktop-tasks.md; nothing lives only in the scratchpad; paid work is cached; ask above $3; measure, never reason.
The reply: no words between tool calls, 600 characters, links first with the PR last, what changed, her questions once, money, need, state; no chat links, no tables, files last.

pages.title: Rules — the house
items: Showing her a change: PHOTO (a screenshot from the container), SANDBOX (a copy of the page in the app), LIVE (a deploy) — ask which; photograph every round.
A merge is a deploy again; never also trigger one. The deploy guard holds for anything drawing, pauses, then lets go; a tap during the pause is queued.
Ask before you deploy; "don't deploy" is not "don't merge" — merge with [skip render] in the squash title, then ask.
Before merging, read what landed under you and what your diff really changes; a diff that is mostly deletions in a file you did not mean to shrink is other chats' work leaving.
Never block the turn on a wait — background it, or her next message is swallowed.
She is almost never at her desktop: a Mac-only task is appended to docs/desktop-tasks.md and mentioned in one line, never asked for. Urgent is the only interrupt.
A YouTube url: run yt-dlp in your own container, not on Render; when the container is refused too, queue the desktop trip.
A claim about other sessions or the environment is measured, never reasoned; a dated measurement goes stale when the environment moves.
A chat's cost is on get_session with its OWN id passed — without the id there is no usage block.
Dashboard links are exact deep links (Render, Firebase, Shopify, Hover); shouldimakethis.com is not an ImageForge domain.
Which environment you are on is read off get_session, never inferred; accounts 2 and 3 each have two "Default" environments and the empty-description one is live.
Links that open the iOS app are ordinary https page urls; a new path goes in both applinks.js and ForgeLinks.swift.
Render is the Starter plan: no spin-down, no hour cap. Build minutes can run out and silently stop every deploy; a docs-only merge with [skip render] costs none.
Dating book work starts from docs/dating-book/THE-SOPHIE-EXPERIMENT.md.
"app" means the iOS app; "web app" means the pages under public/.
Every image deliverable goes into the in-app gallery, every one, labeled; no contact sheets; a re-roll gets a new id and the old stays.
post-to-gallery.js uploads and files in one step, with the true make time; images must live at a public url.
asset-cleanup is not chat-scoped — run it dry and check the number against the chat's real total first.
The server's Firebase project is deckfactory; the app reads membry; two service accounts, both set.
gpt-image-2 and the Replicate LoRAs; saveToFirebase for permanent urls.
Her reference images by her names: sage sandy mirror, sophie book, dream mystery, sophie snake and sophie animals.
Words a human reads run on Claude, never gpt-4o-mini; mini stays for bulk extraction and the Book of Miracles; opening a page never spends money.
Feature branch, PR, merge your own PRs; main moves under you; a conflict in a hand-maintained file is resolved by re-applying your change onto main's copy, never by keeping yours.

pages.title: Rules — the Chats app
items: The hook posts every reply; never also post by hand. A silent chat self-heals by running setup.sh; check the hook version before calling a feature broken.
A chat's identity is its session, not its slug; a reused branch name forks to a -sid6 tail.
The Chats page heals its own staleness; a run of replies with nothing from her between them is one message, and each part folds on its own.
A reply carrying the pipe-to-shell one-liner is unpostable forever — link /setup-line.txt instead.
The harness joins her back-to-back messages into one record; a crashing hook posts nothing and exits 0 — heal before diagnosing.
A chat that never posted cannot heal its past — backfill-chat-history.sh; a silent account is diagnosed by measuring its three settings.
She replies in the app; pick it up when she next messages you, never on a timer.
Register yourself wakeable once per session; never attach text to a wake fire.
The archive wrap-up is her three questions, one sentence each, and the line is her own sentence lifted verbatim.
A bookmark carries a note and tags, offered only at the keeping step; the read box is hers to tick.
A block from a file (chat-block.js) costs no output tokens; her edit comes back as one line, read when you want it.
A list in a reply wears a three-stop box on every item (tick, x, note); her item notes land in the notes inbox — answer them with tick/reply.
The pinned link: two cases only, re-posted on every update; never a Compare page, a PR or a done page.
A pinned film carries her notes and the Prompt button; the film wears our own transport (filmbar.js), never native controls.
The pushpin, the tray, the labels and the tags are hers — a chat never sets or clears them. The Update tab is gone; do not rebuild it.
A lit tag shows every chat wearing the word; a park expires when the chat replies (repliedAt); a bug-fix chat wears a bug and puts itself away.
Every list is split by date and the day turns over at 5am Pacific; the pinned heading folds.
Status cards are telegraphic, 30-60 characters; her note supersedes yours; never write probe text into a live field or a made-up chat name.
Answer a question once, at the top; the bold echo fires only when she says "question" or a code word like "file this".
File yourself; what the work is beats where it happened (a bug fix in the Story Room is bug fix, not story).
The Chats app is the source of truth for a chat's name; never overwrite a displayName she set; read your effective slug from /name with your session.
Her ♥/✕ and notes ride the assets read; a note is a thread — write back on the image; sweep again before saying done; a note on a film shows only in /notes.
Post the exact prompt on every image, split style/content, content opens first; never paraphrase; unknown means file nothing.
Every search box speaks one grammar; Return submits; the phrase ranks first; one row per chat; filters are opt-in three-way toggles; the advanced drawer is one shell.
Chat icons sweep themselves, 25 to a sheet, in her hours.

Posting a page: a list fits a stock template (deck or grid — post the data); otherwise start from the shell; title once and nothing above it; text boxes empty; buttons hug their words; a note on everything; a page's own text never shares the data-item key; a new version is a new page, supersede the old; fix warnings.
A fix to a page builder reaches nothing already posted — repair the live page byte for byte, never rebuild it.

pages.title: Rules — design
items: Nothing stands between the source and the output: her words verbatim, the model's output at full quality, references are originals, a smaller copy is derived.
Never pre-written text in anything she writes in; a placeholder may name the field, never fill it.
Label every image; identical copies dedupe by hash, a re-encoded copy does not — send the original bytes.
Write the prompt short and name the thing, not its parts; the whole prompt is stored wherever an image is made and rides inside the file as XMP.
Post the exact prompt; tell her word for word anything you added; file MODEL · QUALITY · SIZE with the tier; say the quality in the reply; none of it can be backfilled later.
Comparing takes — audio too — is a Compare page, never a list of links; no image link dumps in replies.
No gradients, ever. Her voice on eleven_multilingual_v2, never v3. No Claude-isms in public copy.
Everything slow is a background job that survives leaving the app. Research the current UI before dashboard steps.
Fit it on one screen; two things she cross-references are hairline tabs; open at the level of abstraction she needs.
Back to top and to the bottom ride in the pill's rail; the pill follows whatever is scrolling; change the pill in all seven copies; never name anything .ptop.
A long page keeps her place and names its chapters; the caret stays visible (caretkeep.js); the way out of a big box stays on screen (stickybox.js).
Truncated text opens with an underlined word on the last line, never a button.
Three options is the one tritoggle shell; no toggle cycles on a tap; the neutral stop is in the middle. List · tiles · 3/4 is the one view switch.
No pills; a rounded square or a bare glyph, never a circle; the refresh button is the one exception.
The injected pill reads five tokens from the page — define them; it only appears when there is something to scroll.
A generator's template is probably stale — diff before running any gen-*.py.
Opening an image freezes the page and restores the scroll; one shared lightbox and one shared doors row everywhere; tap-to-next everywhere.
The bottom bar's slots are permanent; iOS bottom bars sit below the keyboard.
One generate glyph (the star); a button that opens a tool wears that tool's icon; Lucide line icons, never emoji; each app keeps its own identity; some pages are deliberately unlinked.
Full clickable links, at the top of the reply, the PR last; never a link to a chat; files and images last; no tables.
Answer questions first and once; 600-character replies; don't hand her your findings; never the questions UI; small question, short answer; quick question mode is one screen.
The page owns its header (pagehead.js); never serve a raw PNG — derive a webp, keep the original lossless; the header top is one number.
A repaint never rebuilds what did not change; hairline tabs measure their own underline; custom icons at 1.11x; the sans is caps and not bold; [hidden] needs !important; the home is one grid.

pages.title: Rules — the modules map
items: Playground — her prompt tester; the feed is hers, a chat draws in its own container and files to its Assets tab (docs/modules/pictures.md).
Shoebox, Squaring, Freeform, the vector pipeline, the card-deck art generator (docs/modules/pictures.md).
Footage — she sends a Seedance clip herself; the cheapest door, the go rule, trims, grab frame, projects and folders, the cast library (docs/modules/audio-and-film.md).
Stitch — pick clips, order them, one button joins them (docs/modules/audio-and-film.md).
Movies, Cutting Blocks, Pausing, Chunking, Assembly, the Film Editor and its cut doc (docs/modules/audio-and-film.md, docs/audio-pipeline.md).
Voice Studio, Voice Memos, the audio drop, the Episode Editor, the Cutting Room, Search, Cut Marks, YouTube upload, grab a video (docs/modules/audio-and-film.md).
The Story Room pad, Story Room data, the Story Timeline, Story Link, the Character Creator, the Writing Room (docs/modules/story.md).
The product pipeline, Etsy, Shopify, Photo → Etsy, Blog Studio, the tarot email, the crystal drop (docs/modules/business.md).
Secretly a Witch and Sticker Day (docs/modules/apps.md); the Anthony Chene NDE project (docs/modules/nde.md).

The fruit poll, the witch-video pipeline, Opinions, Similitude and its two-phone games, Head Games, the Dump, the Update button, the morning brief, the Review Queue, the Instagram mockups, push notifications, the work log, the deliverables list (docs/modules/inbox-and-misc.md).
